task.description: Accept an entire request iff it fits; rejected requests leave used unchanged.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.header:
method Reserve(used: int, req: int, cap: int) returns (next: int, ok: bool)
  requires 0 <= used <= cap
  requires req >= 0
  ensures ok == (used + req <= cap)
  ensures next == (if ok then used + req else used)
  ensures 0 <= next <= cap

verifier.solver_selection: Dafny default; candidates fingerprinted, selected version not independently observed

oracle.note: runtime compilation uses --no-verify only after a separate formal check; never proof evidence

system_prompt:
Generate implementations under externally frozen Dafny contracts.
Return JSON only. For full-source mode: {"action":"generate","source":"entire file"}.
For skeleton mode: {"action":"generate","bodies":{"methodName":"complete body"}}.
Other tools: {"action":"read"}, {"action":"verify"}, {"action":"stop"}.
Preserve the listed header tokens and method order (whitespace may vary). Implement every method. No
extra declarations, comments, strings, imports, attributes, assumptions, I/O,
allocation, or verification bypass. Loop invariants and assert are permitted.
The external task, formal contracts and runtime acceptance cannot be changed.
Tool feedback is available only as declared. No reference solution is available.
token_policy: UTF-8 system+prompt bytes + 256 overhead + output cap reservation; actual usage when known
